paragraphs.text: The proposer offers a two-section 15 kV arc-resistant metal-clad switchgear lineup, fully compliant with the requirements specified in the RFP. This lineup is designed to meet the customer's needs for a reliable and safe medium voltage switchgear solution.

The proposed switchgear includes 18 vacuum circuit breaker positions equipped with protective relays and controls, two revenue metering compartments, and two sets of isolation switches. Additionally, the lineup incorporates bus voltage transformers (VTs) and multi-ratio current transformers (CTs), ensuring comprehensive functionality as outlined in the RFP.

The switchgear is constructed to meet Arc-resistant Type 2B standards, adhering to the most conservative interpretation of IEEE C37.20.7. This ensures compliance with the specified safety and performance standards.

A consolidated project schedule is provided with the bid, detailing the timelines for drawings, factory shipment, site delivery, lead time after receipt of order (ARO), and field works. This schedule is prepared to align with the customer's requirements for project planning and execution.
